name: com.ratezip/rates
title: RateZip Bank Deposit and Mortgage Rates
description: Live US savings, CD, mortgage & HELOC rates with source + timestamp on every figure.

tools.name: compare_deposit_options
tools.description: Compare observed US savings and CD APYs for a balance, holding period, state, monthly-fee, and direct-deposit requirements. Returns sourced facts, unknown/conflicting term checks, and conditional gross-interest illustrations; unknown terms never count as a match. No eligibility decision, personalized offer, application, or account opening. Use for multi-constraint deposit matching; use get_savings_rates or get_cd_rates for simple rate tables, calculate_deposit_earnings_difference for a quick two-APY dollar gap, or get_rate_watch_report for weekly rate-change alerts.

balance.description: Starting deposit in USD; resolves balance-tier APYs and checks opening-deposit minimums (no account identifiers needed).

product.description: Product scope to compare: 'savings' (default), 'cd' (requires a CD term exactly matching horizon_months), or 'all' (both savings and matching-term CDs).

horizon_months.description: Illustrative holding period in months (1-120, default 12). CD gross-interest illustrations require an exactly matching CD term.

state.description: Optional two-letter US state or territory postal code (e.g. 'NY', 'CA') to check published geographic availability; unknown availability stays needs_verification.

require_no_monthly_fee.description: When true, requires zero monthly maintenance fee without a conditional waiver.

require_no_direct_deposit.description: When true, requires the published APY without a direct-deposit requirement.

tools.name: get_savings_rates
tools.description: Current US savings account APYs: FDIC national average plus rates RateZip observed daily on institutions' own published rate pages, each with observation timestamp, source URL, and staleness status. Optional balance resolves applicable balance-tier APYs and ranks by earnings; state adds an availability/eligibility note; credit_score returns a clarifying note only (deposit APYs do not vary by credit). Use for a quick current savings rate table; use compare_deposit_options when filtering by monthly-fee/direct-deposit/state requirements, calculate_deposit_earnings_difference for dollar yield gaps, or get_rate_watch_report for historical movement and alerts. Factual rate data only; does not endorse providers, offer financial advice, open accounts, or submit applications. Pass max_results to cap the number of rows and include_provenance=false for a shorter response.

balance.description: Deposit balance in USD — resolves the applicable tier APY and ranks by what you'd earn

state.description: Two-letter state — adds an availability/eligibility note

credit_score.description: FICO — deposit APYs generally don't vary by credit; returns a clarifying note only

max_results.description: Cap the number of observed rows returned, in the payload's ordering. Omit for all.

include_provenance.description: false omits the per-source provenance block (snapshot ids, attributions); each row keeps its own observed_at and source_url.

tools.name: get_cd_rates
tools.description: Current US CD APYs: FDIC national averages by term plus RateZip-observed institution CD rates with terms, minimums/conditions, observation timestamps, source URLs, and staleness status. Pass term_months (e.g. 3, 6, 12, 24, 36, 60) to filter to one term or omit for all terms grouped by term; if no institution publishes the requested term, available terms are listed. Optional balance resolves applicable balance-tier APYs and re-ranks by earnings; state adds an availability/eligibility note; credit_score returns a clarifying note only (CD APYs do not vary by credit). Use for current CD rate listings by term; use compare_deposit_options for multi-constraint fee/direct-deposit/state matching, or get_rate_watch_report for historical rate-change alerts and brokered CDs. Factual rate data only; does not endorse providers, offer financial advice, open accounts, or submit applications. Pass max_results to cap the number of rows and include_provenance=false for a shorter response.

term_months.description: CD term in months to filter to (e.g. 6, 12, 24, 60). Omit for all terms grouped by term.

balance.description: Deposit balance in USD — resolves the applicable tier APY and ranks by what you'd earn

state.description: Two-letter state — adds an availability/eligibility note

credit_score.description: FICO — deposit APYs generally don't vary by credit; returns a clarifying note only

max_results.description: Cap the number of observed rows returned, in the payload's ordering. Omit for all.

include_provenance.description: false omits the per-source provenance block (snapshot ids, attributions); each row keeps its own observed_at and source_url.

tools.name: get_rate_watch_report
tools.description: Monitor and rank observed US deposit APYs (savings, retail CDs, brokered CDs) alongside separately labeled money market fund 7-day SEC yields, comparing current observations against a historical baseline (compare_to: 7-day 'previous_snapshot' or an explicit YYYY-MM-DD UTC date) and the latest verified FOMC decision. Returns top_n highest-yielding rows, explicitly tracked institutions (even outside top_n), removed products, and threshold alerts (below_floor/crossed_below_floor relative to alert_floor_apy_percent; big_move when |delta| >= big_move_threshold_pct_points; new_product; removed_product; new_fed_decision). Use for periodic rate-movement monitoring, threshold alerts, brokered CDs, or money market fund comparisons; use get_savings_rates or get_cd_rates for simple current rate tables, or compare_deposit_options for multi-constraint account matching. Factual comparisons only.

products.description: Product categories to rank and monitor: 'savings', 'cd', 'money_market_fund' (reported as 7-day SEC yield separately from deposit APY), and 'brokered_cd'. Defaults to all four.

cd_terms_months.description: CD and brokered CD terms in months to include (defaults to [6, 11, 12, 13, 15, 18, 24, 48, 60]). Ignored for savings and money market funds.

institutions.description: Optional bank, credit union, or fund names to track explicitly in watched_institutions even if they fall outside top_n or have no current observation.

top_n.description: Maximum number of highest-yielding observed rows to return in rows (1-20, default 7). Watched institutions outside this cutoff still appear in watched_institutions.

alert_floor_apy_percent.description: Yield floor in percent (default 4.5). Any fresh top-N or watched row below this floor emits a below_floor alert, plus crossed_below_floor if its prior snapshot was at or above the floor.

big_move_threshold_pct_points.description: Minimum absolute yield change in percentage points versus compare_to (default 0.25) required to emit a big_move alert.

compare_to.description: Historical baseline for change_vs_prior deltas and alerts: 'previous_snapshot' (7 days before report time, default) or a YYYY-MM-DD UTC date preceding the report time.

state.description: Optional two-letter US state or territory postal code (e.g. 'NY', 'CA') — adds a state availability/eligibility note in personalization.state.

balance.description: Optional deposit balance in USD — resolves applicable_apy_percent for balance-tiered savings/CDs and ranks rows by what that balance earns (money market funds use 7-day SEC yield).

include_provenance.description: When true (default), includes per-source snapshot provenance metadata; set false for a compact response (each row keeps observed_at and source_url).

include_stale_in_alerts.description: When false (default), only fresh observations generate alerts; set true to also include stale (non-excluded) observations in alert evaluation.

tools.name: get_mortgage_rates
tools.description: Current US mortgage and HELOC rates refreshed daily from lenders' own published rate pages, grouped by loan type (e.g. '30-year fixed', '15-year fixed', 'HELOC'), each with note rate, APR, representative-scenario assumptions, observation timestamp, source URL, and staleness status. Coverage reflects observed national and multi-state lenders (availability varies by state licensing; no third-party national-average benchmark is redistributed). Pass loan_type to filter to one type or omit for all; optional loan_amount, state, and credit_score add educational/licensing context without fabricating personal rates. Use for observed lender mortgage and HELOC rate tables; use compare_home_equity_payments to model monthly payment schedules from explicit rate, balance, and term assumptions. Factual rate data only; does not produce personalized quotes, imply approval, or endorse lenders. Pass max_results to cap the number of rows and include_provenance=false for a shorter response.

loan_type.description: Loan type to filter to, e.g. '30-year fixed', '15-year fixed', or 'HELOC'. Omit for all.

loan_amount.description: Loan amount in USD — compares with the 2026 one-unit baseline conforming loan limit; county/unit limits and eligibility require separate verification (does not fabricate a rate)

state.description: Two-letter state — adds an availability/licensing note

credit_score.description: FICO — returns EDUCATIONAL context only; never a fabricated credit-adjusted rate

max_results.description: Cap the number of observed rows returned, in the payload's ordering. Omit for all.

include_provenance.description: false omits the per-source provenance block (snapshot ids, attributions); each row keeps its own observed_at and source_url.

tools.name: compare_home_equity_payments
tools.description: Calculate and compare 1 to 8 home equity loan or HELOC monthly payment scenarios from explicit caller-supplied amount, note interest rate, and term assumptions. Models fully amortizing repayment, an optional HELOC interest-only draw phase, an optional repayment rate change, and one-time cash/financed fees. Returns per-scenario phase payments, monthly payment change at repayment, and modeled interest/outflow totals. Use for caller-supplied payment math; call get_mortgage_rates(loan_type='HELOC') first if the caller needs observed published HELOC rates instead of supplying their own rate. No lender quote, eligibility decision, rate selection, or APR calculation; omitted fees stay unknown; no personal identifiers needed.

label.description: Short unique scenario name (e.g. 'HELOC 8% 5yr draw'); do not include personal identifiers.

product_type.description: Loan structure: 'home_equity_loan' (fixed fully amortizing; requires interest_only_months=0) or 'heloc' (supports an optional interest-only draw phase before amortization).

amount_borrowed.description: USD cash borrowed or initially drawn, excluding any financed fees.

annual_interest_rate_percent.description: Caller-supplied note interest rate, not APR; 8 means 8%. Do not infer a borrower's rate.

repayment_months.description: Number of fully amortizing monthly payments AFTER any interest-only phase.

interest_only_months.description: HELOC only: assumed interest-only draw months, followed by full amortization. No additional draws.

repayment_interest_rate_percent.description: Optional rate-change scenario at the start of repayment after interest-only months. Otherwise the same rate continues.

fees.description: Optional one-time fee assumptions. Omit if unknown; omitted fees are excluded, not represented as confirmed zero.

upfront_cash.description: One-time fees paid in cash, in USD. Enter 0 only if explicitly assumed or confirmed.

financed.description: One-time fees added to the balance, in USD. Do not include these in amount_borrowed.

scenarios.description: One to eight explicit payment assumptions. Ask for missing amount, note rate and term, or clearly agree on hypothetical examples.

tools.name: calculate_deposit_earnings_difference
tools.description: Calculate the illustrative annualized USD earnings difference between two savings APYs for a given balance and horizon (years). Defaults: current_apy_percent = FDIC national average savings rate, comparison_apy_percent = highest RateZip-observed savings APY. Returns rounded USD amounts (current_end_balance, comparison_end_balance, earnings_difference = comparison_end_balance - current_end_balance; positive when comparison_apy_percent > current_apy_percent, negative when lower), explicit omissions (taxes, penalties, rate changes, tiers, availability), and provenance for defaulted rates. Use when the caller wants the dollar yield gap between two APYs; use get_savings_rates or compare_deposit_options to browse or filter institution rates first. Illustrative calculation only; not financial advice.

current_apy_percent.description: APY the money earns today (%); defaults to the FDIC national average savings rate

comparison_apy_percent.description: APY to compare against (%); defaults to the highest RateZip-observed savings APY

tools.name: get_state_auto_benchmarks
tools.description: Audited 2024-2026 sample auto insurance price spreads and cheapest open-market carrier win counts from 10 official US state insurance department (.gov) publications (53,685 quotes across 1,303 standardized profiles in CA, TX, MD, KY, NV, AL, OK, ND, WV, and DC). Pass a state code/name for one jurisdiction (with official .gov rate-guide URL and top carriers) or omit state for the 10-jurisdiction overview. States without a current carrier-level .gov table return an explicit unavailable explanation and the NAIC state regulator directory. Use for state-level .gov market spreads and carrier win counts; use check_auto_carrier_quality for insurer financial strength ratings, or compare_auto_quotes to normalize caller-supplied quotes. Factual benchmark data only; does not produce personalized quotes or endorse insurers.

state.description: Two-letter US state code or full state name (e.g. 'CA', 'Texas', 'DC'). Omit for the 10-jurisdiction overview.

coverage_type.description: Filter multi-state overview to 'full_coverage' or 'minimum_liability'. Ignored when a specific state is requested.

include_carriers.description: Include top open-market carrier win leaderboard for a requested state (default true).

max_results.description: Cap the number of carrier rows (for a single state) or state rows (for the overview).

tools.name: check_auto_carrier_quality
tools.description: Factual carrier standing lookup for US auto insurers: verified AM Best or Demotech financial strength rating status (active, withdrawn, or not rated), underwriting subsidiary notes, eligibility restrictions, public regulatory context, and direct NAIC Consumer Insurance Search lookup guidance (where the NAIC Complaint Index uses 1.00 as the national baseline relative to market share: below 1.00 = fewer complaints than expected, above 1.00 = more). Optionally pass state to cross-reference presence in RateZip's 10-state .gov pricing study. Carriers outside the verified registry return unknown rather than estimated ratings. Use to verify an insurer's financial strength and complaint lookup instructions; use get_state_auto_benchmarks for state .gov price spreads, or compare_auto_quotes to compare caller-supplied quotes. Factual reference data only; does not endorse insurers.

carrier_name.description: Auto insurance brand or underwriting company name (e.g. 'First Acceptance', 'GEICO Secure', 'CSAA', 'Tesla Insurance', 'Branch').

state.description: Optional two-letter US state code or state name to cross-reference presence in RateZip's 10-state .gov study.

tools.name: compare_auto_quotes
tools.description: Normalize 1 to 10 caller-supplied auto insurance quotes (monthly, 6-month, or annual, plus optional fees) to annualized and monthly-equivalent USD cost, rank lowest to highest, calculate savings/differences against an optional current declarations-page policy, flag coverage downgrades (lower liability limits, higher deductibles, or omitted UM/UIM), and attach verified carrier financial-strength context when recognized. Returns ranked_quotes, optional current_policy_baseline, and scope limitations. Use only when the caller supplies quotes to compare; use get_state_auto_benchmarks for state .gov market spreads or check_auto_carrier_quality to look up an insurer without quotes. Mathematical comparison of supplied inputs only; does not produce binding offers or endorse insurers.

current_policy.description: Optional current declarations-page policy details used as the apples-to-apples baseline for savings and coverage-downgrade checks.

label.description: Label for current policy (defaults to 'Current policy').

carrier.description: Insurer or underwriting company name (optional; cross-referenced against RateZip's verified carrier quality registry when supplied).

premium_usd.description: Quoted or current policy premium in USD for the specified term_months.

term_months.description: Policy billing/pricing period in months: 6 (semi-annual), 12 (annual), or 1 (monthly).

fees_usd.description: Optional policy, billing, or installment fees in USD charged per term (defaults to 0 when omitted; omitted fees remain unknown if charged by the insurer).

bi_per_person_usd.description: Bodily injury liability limit per person in USD (e.g. 100000 for 100/300/100).

bi_per_accident_usd.description: Bodily injury liability limit per accident in USD (e.g. 300000 for 100/300/100).

pd_limit_usd.description: Property damage liability limit in USD (e.g. 100000 for 100/300/100).

um_uim_included.description: Whether Uninsured/Underinsured Motorist (UM/UIM) coverage is included.

label.description: Short label for this quote (e.g. 'Quote A - CSAA').

carrier.description: Insurer or underwriting company name (optional; cross-referenced against RateZip's verified carrier quality registry when supplied).

premium_usd.description: Quoted or current policy premium in USD for the specified term_months.

term_months.description: Policy billing/pricing period in months: 6 (semi-annual), 12 (annual), or 1 (monthly).

fees_usd.description: Optional policy, billing, or installment fees in USD charged per term (defaults to 0 when omitted; omitted fees remain unknown if charged by the insurer).

bi_per_person_usd.description: Bodily injury liability limit per person in USD (e.g. 100000 for 100/300/100).

bi_per_accident_usd.description: Bodily injury liability limit per accident in USD (e.g. 300000 for 100/300/100).

pd_limit_usd.description: Property damage liability limit in USD (e.g. 100000 for 100/300/100).

um_uim_included.description: Whether Uninsured/Underinsured Motorist (UM/UIM) coverage is included.

quotes.description: One to ten caller-supplied auto insurance quotes to normalize to annualized cost, rank, and audit for coverage differences.
